LanguageData.HNL_Intro: Choose who is exempt from each title requirement. Permanent colonists include travelling members, but exclude visitors, temporary quest members, prisoners and slaves. Changes apply to subsequent checks without a restart.
LanguageData.HNL_BedroomTip: Exempt title requirements for a personal bedroom, area, impressiveness and furnishings, including associated mood penalties. Ordinary room and ideology rules remain.
LanguageData.HNL_ThroneroomTip: Exempt daily throne room and furnishing requirements and their mood penalties. Bestowing quests always retain their venue and luxury checks.
LanguageData.HNL_ApparelStyleTip: Exempt mood penalties for missing title-specific apparel. Visitor equipment generation and ideology apparel requirements remain.
LanguageData.HNL_ApparelQualityTip: Exempt minimum apparel quality imposed by titles and its mood penalty, independently of apparel style.
LanguageData.HNL_FoodTip: Exempt title food refusals and newly generated title food memories. Alerts are filtered per pawn. Existing memories expire naturally; ordinary food and ideology restrictions remain.
LanguageData.HNL_ExpectationsTip: Remove only the title's minimum expectation. Wealth, ideology roles and vanilla grace periods remain.
LanguageData.HNL_WorkTip: Remove only work restrictions caused by titles. Backstory, traits, health, genes and ideology restrictions remain, as do decrees and recreation rules. Newly unlocked work may need priorities assigned manually.
LanguageData.HNL_Footer: Bestowing ceremonies and their throne room requirements always remain. Titles, honor, permits, diplomacy, decrees and recreation rules remain. Settings apply across saves; restoring rules does not reconstruct past memories or work assignments.
LanguageData.HNL_PatchFailure: Patching failed and this mod's rule changes are disabled. Check Player.log. The selected policies are not active.
